transcription_notes: Hand: GG-00106 careful 3-column book hand (LXX / 3-Kingdoms recension). Damage: generally clean; one faded word at f031r-M L19 rendered as the ⟦illegible⟧ sentinel; the Temple-dimension and door-count numerals are red and small (at the JPG resolution limit), transcribed as inked and flagged. Boundary START: 1Ki6 begins at f031r-L ~line 27, immediately after the red rubric ክፍል ፡ [numeral] ❈ that follows the close of 1Ki5 ('…ወወደይዎን'); incipit ወውእቱ ፡ ቤት ፡ ዘሐነፀ ፡ ሰሎምን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ለእግዚአብሐር ('And this is the house that Solomon the king built for the LORD') — i.e. this recension opens 1Ki6 with the Temple description, NOT the KJV 'in the 480th/fourth year' formula (that dating clause appears at the chapter END here). Boundary STOP: 1Ki6 ends at f031v-L line 14 with '…ወፈጸመ ፡ (ፊጸመ) ፡ ቤት ፡ ወኩሎ ፡ ሥርዓቱ ✣ ወሐነጸ ፡ በ፯ ፡ ዓመት' ('he finished the house and all its ordinances, and built it in seven years'); immediately after, the red rubric ክፍል ፡ ፴ ❈ introduces 1Ki7 with 'ወሐነጸ ፡ ቤዶ ፡ ሰሎምን ፡ በ፲ወ፫ ዓመት' ('Solomon built HIS OWN house in 13 years') + the House of the Forest of Lebanon (…ሊባናስ ፡ ፻ በእመት ኑኁ). The ክፍል ፡ ፴ rubric and everything after it is 1Ki7 and is NOT transcribed. Span actually transcribed: f031r-L (from ~L27) → f031r-M (full) → f031r-R (full) → f031v-L (L1–~L14). Read L→M→R within a folio, then the f031r-R-foot → f031v-L-top folio turn (running text continuous across every column/folio turn; verified, no skipped line). Scribal conventions per GG topology: small red inter-word marks = ፡ (wordspace); the larger body-cross ✣ is kept inline as a clause/sentence separator (the tokenizer strips it); the knot-cross ❈ follows each red ክፍል rubric. Intra-chapter red ክፍል/ክፍ rubrics are LITURGICAL subdivisions (not modern chapters) and were observed mid-chapter at: the chapter head (f031r-L ~L27), f031r-L foot (after ወለዳቢርሂ), f031r-M (after the cedar-lining clause ~L15; before the divine word ~L22; after በዘገበዋቲሁ ~L28), f031r-R (top before the altar; ~L4 before the cherubim; ~L26 before the doors), and f031v-L (~L6 before the inner court; ~L8). Their exact red numerals are at the JPG resolution limit (mostly ፳/፴ range, single-glyph) and are recorded here rather than as verse boundaries — the running narrative defines the chapter; the verse division below follows the LXX sense-units. Anti-harmonization watch (per GG topology §1/§2): the body-cross ✣ was NOT promoted to fidel እ in 2nd-person-suffix-ከ positions; ሠ/ሥ, ለ/ስ, ፈ/ረ, ቤ/በ, ኃ/ሐ and a/o vowel-order confusions were read as inked, not toward any printed form. Internal spelling variants (ዘይት vs ዘዴት for 'olive'; ዜሳን; ባዕድ for the month 'Bul') are transcribed as written and flagged. Blind transcription from the two GG images only (no second witness, no KJV/skeleton).
